release_1_4_0.scope: Mac product only: Debian daily/development package presets and live initialization output. Common runtime and iPad code unchanged.

packages.default: Built-in Debian installs daily tools before publishing a new environment. minimal skips setup; development adds C/C++, make, pkgconf, Python venv/pip, CMake and Ninja.
packages.upgrade: env packages NAME [standard|development] operates on an existing stopped built-in Debian environment without replacing its files. No automatic package work on normal boot or application upgrade.
packages.failure: Fresh network-off setup failed and discarded its unpublished staging store; minimal offline base succeeded. Package names use real dpkg entries (bind9-dnsutils/pkgconf), avoiding virtual-name false misses.
packages.daily: Daily tools installed and executed, CA trust verified with real HTTPS curl. Offline repeat passed in 0.51 seconds. First setup took 425.90 seconds in the focused run; an earlier equivalent daily install took 516.03 seconds. Ordered functional observations, not a performance benchmark.
packages.development: Passed real C/C++ compile and execution, Python 3.13 venv with SSL/sqlite3 and pip, CMake + Ninja configure/build/run, pkg-config. Development setup took 806.17 seconds; workflow verification 31.49 seconds; offline repeat 0.95 seconds. Functional observations, not a throughput benchmark.

gui_output.implementation: Merged stdout/stderr pipe readiness events, incremental UTF-8 conversion and main-queue text updates. Completion waits for both process exit and pipe EOF; no polling timer or per-guest-I/O hook.
gui_output.native_tests: Passed: output before exit, split Chinese/emoji, incomplete UTF-8 at EOF, final non-newline text, merged stderr, large output, error status and launch failure.
gui_output.actual_manager_test: Passed against the real manager class/text view: Chinese progress appeared while the child was still running; final text retained; actions restored; quiet list refresh preserved the log. Invalid/null configuration rows also return an error instead of crashing the Install Tools action.

verification.local_product_steps_1_through_10: passed; includes formatting, boundaries, clippy, unit tests, Python/shell checks, native manager regressions and both channel builds
verification.cli_installation: passed: generic rootfs, configuration, rollback, installer and idempotent shell PATH; version assertion now follows the tested runner instead of hardcoding 1.3
verification.stable_dev_isolation: passed: distinct bundle/config/CLI identities, simultaneous guests, independent stop, dev reinstall preserves stable
verification.package_acceptance: 14 operations passed, including expected invalid-option/network-off failures, staged cleanup, default daily installation, real HTTPS, offline idempotence and development workflows.

release_1_4_0.signing: Stable product channel; local ad-hoc/unnotarized distribution as previously selected. This machine has no Developer ID Application identity. No notarization or Gatekeeper acceptance is claimed.
release_1_4_0.driver_source_archive: Exact linked MoltenVK SHA-256 538c5a1f3f73dbcf1bdb91d80353ea9b6997d4724769227eb373569af6eec77d matches the bundled build record. All 34 original archives/recipes/patch/native files match; two additional archive entries are generated build documentation/record.
limitations: First package installation is still slow due to ordinary private-store namespace checkpoints/synchronization; this release does not change persistence policy. Existing environments are never silently reset or upgraded.
